title: Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course
abstract: arXiv:2609.08832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future

translated_title: 弥合一致性差距：学会保持正轨的自我进化智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体虽然在平均意义上可以表现出准确性，但在生产环境中却可能不可靠，这一差异虽然早已被观察到，但基本上仍未得到解决。在AppWorld基准测试中，使用GPT-4.1的ReAct智能体执行同一任务五次时，仅有53%的概率在全部五次运行中都成功，尽管其单次运行的平均通过率高达77%。我们将这24个百分点的差距称为“一致性差距”，并认为解决这一问题是实现可信赖的AI智能体部署的先决条件。我们提出了一个自我进化智能体框架，通过识别智能体轨迹中不稳定的、一致性低的步骤，并将其转化为智能体在未来运行中可以调用的情景记忆，从而缩小这一差距。该框架的核心是一个一致性分析器，用于精确定位轨迹在多次执行中可能在何处以及为何发生翻转；以及一个指南生成器，将诊断结果转化为有针对性的指南，提交至记忆并注入未来的运行中。
tldr: 本文提出一个自我进化智能体框架，通过一致性分析器识别轨迹中的不稳定步骤，并借助指南生成器将其转化为情景记忆，从而弥合LLM智能体平均准确率与实际运行可靠性之间24个百分点的“一致性差距”。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-evolving agent framework that closes the 24-point consistency gap between average accuracy and run-to-run reliability of LLM agents by using a Consistency Analyzer to pinpoint unstable trajectory steps and a Guideline Generator to convert them into episodic memory for future runs.
